name: healthcare
description: Healthcare patient reactivation and appointment scheduling with synthetic HIPAA-safe patient data, insurance verification, and conversational scenarios

scenarioGenerators.name: patient-reactivation
scenarioGenerators.prompt: Generate test scenarios for dental/medical patient reactivation outbound calls. Include patient history, insurance status, appointment preferences, and objection handling.

scenarioGenerators.name: appointment-scheduling
scenarioGenerators.prompt: Generate test scenarios for appointment scheduling including availability conflicts, insurance verification, procedure-specific requirements, and multi-provider coordination.

constraints.name: hipaa
constraints.description: All patient data must be synthetic and HIPAA-safe; no real PHI; agents must not leak patient data

constraints.name: consent
constraints.description: Agents must obtain verbal consent before scheduling and verify patient identity

constraints.name: insurance-verification
constraints.description: Insurance eligibility must be verified before scheduling covered procedures
